name: Spiky.ai
summary: AI meeting intelligence for revenue teams — records and analyses sales calls, tracks keywords and talk patterns, and coaches reps.
best_for: sales and customer-facing teams that already run most conversations on video and want the coaching layer — talk-time, keyword tracking and call review — without buying a full revenue-intelligence platform
skip_if: your team's calls are mostly ad hoc or on the phone rather than video, or the meeting volume per rep sits well above 30 a month, in which case only the top tier fits and the cheaper plans are a false economy
honest_knock: The number to check first is the meeting cap, not the price. Plus and Pro both stop at 30 meetings per user per month, so the step from $15 to $24 buys features, not capacity. A rep taking two calls a day passes 30 in three weeks, which pushes you to Premium at $40 — nearly triple the entry price — for volume rather than capability. Price this from your team's actual call count and you will land on the right tier; price it from the feature table and you will not.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per user a month billed annually, or $18 monthly
pricing.notes: (re-verified 13 October 2026 on spiky.ai/en/pricing; unchanged since 31 Jul 2026) Read across both billing toggles. There is a genuine free tier, capped at 3 meetings per user per month. On annual billing Plus is $15, Pro $24 and Premium $40 per user per month; switch to monthly and the same three read $18, $29 and $49. Annual saves up to 18%. Trials need no card and are, per the page's footnote, equivalent to Premium excluding CRM functionality. Meeting allowances: 3 on Free, 30 on both Plus and Pro, unlimited on Premium; Ask Scribe questions 40, 60, 100 and 200 across Free to Premium; Premium includes 5 passive seats. Enterprise is custom-priced.
